name: PHerc0814 control (reproduces official AUC)
summary: Same crop and held-out pixels as the official ink_9um validation mask (bench/fetch_ink9um_val.py), villa inference on CPU. Published AUCs from the checkpoints' own evaluations.

nodes.question: Does the model see known ink on this labelled segment?
nodes.answer: Low-power control: inkcheck reproduces the official AUC, so the scoring matches the official evaluation.
evidence: Only 2 reference strokes (< 10): the stroke test has almost no power, so PASS is out of reach by design; AUC is the number to compare.

AUC reproduces the published value (|Δ| ≤ 0.02) for 4 of 4 checkpoints with a published AUC: dense9um all7 0.939 vs 0.935, dense9um w016-excluded 0.930 vs 0.930, ink_9um seed42 75k 0.884 vs 0.874, Erwin soup42_last4 0.870 vs 0.881.
nodes.next_step: Use this as the pipeline control; run the full decision tree on a full labelled segment.
